reviews.title: Friendly and competent
reviews.text: We had a smooth flight. We we're served cookies and excellent fruit juice. The airport staff at Tamale was very friendly. When they discovered a laptop in our checked-in bagage at the x-ray, they found us in the waiting area and gave us the opportunity to take it out for it not to be damaged.
reviews.author: LikeditNijmegen

reviews.title: Competent, good prices
reviews.text: I have made several trips with Starbow between Accra and Tamale. The flights are sometimes delayed for up to an hour. I have never been canceled. The cabin crew and ground staff are helpful. I make my reservations online and that works fine.
reviews.author: Ed L

reviews.title: Cancelled without informing
reviews.text: I went with Starbow from Accra to Kumasi and although the trip was slightly delayed it was overall not a bad experience. However, on the return trip I arrived at the airport to find that my flight had been cancelled and that nobody had alerted me to this. I had to catch a flight from the other airline (AWA) in order to catch my connecting flight from Accra. However, they required that I pay extra and be on the waiting list. Thankfully the AWA flight was delayed for 2 hours therefore I was able to get a seat on that flight.
reviews.author: jchuii

reviews.title: Short trip to Damang
reviews.text: I made two trips on Starbow Airlines back and forth to Accra. It is a very short trip time-wise but the cabin crews are friendly, efficient and great looking. A small packet of biscuits, water and fruit juice is served with a minimum of fuss and baggage is handled well and you see it going on and off the flight. This is always re-assuring when traveling on internal flights in Africa. The aircraft are clean and well presented and I must say this is one of my better experiences.
reviews.author: Nigel B
